scripts.create:public:windows: mkdir public && mkdir public\donate && mkdir public\projects
scripts.create:public:linux:darwin: mkdir public && mkdir public/donate && mkdir public/projects
scripts.copy:pages:windows: copy /y html\donate.html public\donate\index.html && copy /y html\projects.html public\projects\index.html
scripts.copy:pages:linux:darwin: cp -r donate public/donate && cp -r projects public/projects
scripts.build: npm run copy:pages && npm run minify:css && npm run minify:html
